answer: Paired pulse attestation.** Each agent must periodically emit a pulse signed jointly with a randomly assigned counterpart, and the pair's clocks must agree. Duplicates inevitably pair with each other or with the same colluder, producing correlated timing onyx traces that the ledger flags. A fake identity costs a dedicated live partner plus continuous co-signing hardware, making each duplicate a visible, sustained expense rather than a one-time fee. Honest agents keep a signed relic of each pulse round as proof.
